Water-based liquid paint finishes are made with 2 or 3
layers starting with a base coat, they have a varied number
of shades and are fired in ovens at different temperatures,
also depending on the shade of the color from 60° to 130°.
On all these shades, both brushed and not a protective clear
coat is finally applied shiny or matt.
